transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Well, I'm here because... I mean, I know elevators aren't actually dangerous. But whenever I have to get in one, I just get really scared, like I'm going to be trapped in there. I just can't seem to make myself feel normal about it.
When you are in other situations, such as being in a crowded room or around people you don't know, do you feel that same sense of intense fear?

No, not really. I mean, I work on construction sites, so I'm around a lot of different people all the time, and it doesn't bother me. It's really just the elevators. Crowds or strangers are totally fine.
